start.codeOnly: We sent a 6-digit code to your address. It is valid for 10 minutes, and you do not need another password.

resume.title: Pick up where you stopped?
resume.body: We saved what you already answered.

language.title: Which language are you learning?
language.body: Pick one. You can add more later.
language.soon: For now this language has words and games. A full program is coming.

focus.title: What matters most to you in English?
focus.body: We build your day from this. There is no wrong answer.

words.title: Remember words I meet online
words.body: Read or watch things in English? Save a word with one click and practise it at the right time.

goal.title: Reach a goal
goal.body: Travel, work, study or a move abroad. An AI teacher builds you a personal plan.

scratch.title: Learn from scratch
scratch.body: Don't know a word yet? A ready-made program, step by step.

focus.note: You can combine everything later: program, AI teacher and words from the extension.

literacy.title: Do you read English?
literacy.body: An honest answer helps us choose the first question.
literacy.starting: We'll start with the basics: letters and sounds, and speaking at the same time.

pocket.introTitle: Let's see what's already in your pocket
pocket.introBody: Know the word? Tap "I know it". Not yet? "Not yet". No score, no mistakes. About 3 minutes.
pocket.slowDown: Hold on, let's slow down a little.
pocket.fakeFound_one: We caught one word that doesn't exist 😄 that's exactly what it's for.
pocket.fakeFound_other: We caught {{count}} words that don't exist 😄 that's exactly what they're for.
pocket.verifyTitle: Want to see some pocket words in action?

result.title: Here's what we found
result.outOf: out of the {{total}} core words GotIt teaches. This is an estimate.
result.speaking: Speaking: we'll check it in your first conversation with the teacher.
result.note: This is a starting point, not a grade. The plan updates as you practise.
result.uncertain: The estimate is a little wide; the first lessons will fine-tune it.

summary.Pre-A1: We'll start with the very first steps, gently.
summary.A1: You recognise simple words and sentences; now we build a solid base.
summary.A2: You get by in familiar everyday situations.
summary.B1: You follow the main points and can hold a conversation; now we sharpen.
summary.B2: You read and understand comfortably; now we work on precision and nuance.
summary.C1: You're at a high level; now we focus on accuracy and style.

plan.title: Let's build your plan
plan.body: Three short choices, and the plan updates in front of you.
plan.sim: {{minutes}} min a day ← you reach the goal in {{low}}–{{high}} months
plan.needed: For {{deadline}} you need about {{minutes}} min a day.
plan.dailyNote: Words you save with the extension do not add to the daily goal.

firstWords.title: Your first {{count}} words. Let's go!
firstWords.body: These are words not in your pocket yet, at your level.
firstWords.counter: {{done}} of {{total}} first words in your pocket
firstWords.tomorrow: Tomorrow they come back for a short review so they don't fade.
firstWords.none: Let's begin your first day in the program.

save.title: Saving what you built
save.body: A free account, so your progress is never lost.
save.trialBody: Program, AI teacher and extension. No credit card. Near the end we'll suggest the track that suits you best.
save.terms: By signing up you agree to the terms of use and the privacy policy.
save.existing: You already started a program, so we left it as it is.
save.failed: We couldn't save your plan. You can continue and rebuild it in settings.

today.title: Today's task
today.gap: Words from the units you skipped come back for short reviews, 3 a day.

tutorLock.title: Conversation with the teacher opens soon
tutorLock.body: To make the conversation truly useful we start with a small base. {{left}} more units and conversation opens.

courses.title: Learning programs are part of Pro
courses.body: A personal plan, graded units and an AI teacher. Words, the extension and games stay free, always.

tutor.title: Conversation with the teacher is part of Pro
tutor.body: Conversations with a real task, at your level. Words, the extension and games stay free, always.

locked.preview: This is a preview. To study the units you need Pro or the trial.

tutorIntro.title: You already know enough for a short chat
tutorIntro.body: Want to meet Rachel, your teacher? A 3–5 minute conversation about things you already know. No pressure, and you can stop any time.

hero.ctaPrimary: Find out what's in your pocket · 3 min
hero.promise: No credit card · 14 days of Pro, free
hero.mochiAlt: Moochi, GotIt's learning companion, holding a word card

try.title: Try 3 words
try.doneBody: Want to check the whole pocket? 3 minutes.

pocket.title: How many words are already in your pocket?
pocket.body: A 3-minute check that feels like a game. No score, no mistakes. At the end: your level, how many words you already have, and a plan that starts exactly in the right place.
pocket.cta: Find out what's in your pocket

plan.title: A plan that fits you exactly
plan.body: Start at the right unit, skip what you already know without leaving gaps, and set the pace by your goal and your time.

tutor.title: A teacher who talks about what interests you
tutor.body: Conversations with a real task: book a table, set up a meeting, tell about your weekend. A gentle correction at the end and three new phrases saved for you.
tutor.opens: She opens up once you have a base to talk from.
tutor.task: Task: book a table for four on Friday
tutor.teacher: Good evening! How can I help you?
tutor.you: I want a table for four, please.

pricing.title: Free forever, and more when you want it
pricing.body: Prices are shown when you sign up. Cancel any time.

level.q: Do I need to read English?
level.a: No. If you don't read yet, we start with letters and sounds and teach you to speak at the same time.

test.q: How long does the level check take?
test.a: About 3 minutes. No score, and you may answer "not yet" to any word.

price.a: Saving words with the extension, practice and games are free forever. Learning programs and the teacher are included in the 14-day trial, with no credit card, and after that in Pro.

cta.title: 3 minutes and you know exactly where to start
cta.body: No sign-up before the check. You only save the result and the plan if it suits you.
cta.button: Find out what's in your pocket

landingV2.mobileBar: Find out what's in your pocket · 3 min

how.title: How it works: mark, play, remember
how.intro: Two small steps a day, and every word you meet actually stays.

mark.title: Mark a word on any site
mark.body: The Chrome extension saves the word with its sentence and the site you found it on, so you remember where you met it.

games.title: Turn it into a short game
games.body: Your saved words come back as flashcards, matching and fill-in-the-gap, right when you start forgetting them.
games.free: Games and the extension are free, always.
games.matchPrompt: Match each word to its translation
games.matchHint: Tap a word, then its translation
games.gapHint: Pick the word that fits the meaning
games.finished: Well done! 3 words in your memory
